🛡️ Army Doctrine ATP 4-16 App. C: True 1D Arc-Length Road Stationing

"Convoy spacing, column length, and road space are measured strictly along the road centerline (arc-length coordinate s)." Under Euclidean heading offsets, followers cut corners across open terrain into ditches and tree lines. Arc-length stationing constrains follower targets to the surveyed road curve (s* = sref - rank × eff_gap), preserving lateral lane discipline and road headway around 90-degree turns.
